name: Metro White Gloss Tile

media.alt_text: Metro White Gloss Tile fitted on bathroom wall with black matt accessories.

tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

description:
Our Metro White tile has been independently tested against our competitors version of this tile. It has proven to be superior in quality in the following categories:

  • Colour

Our biggest seller, the Metro white tile, is both versatile and stylish. Ideal for use in kitchens and bathrooms, the white tiles can be creatively mixed to add distinction to almost any space.

name: Astrea™ Duck Egg Tile
tile_care:
Pre-treatment
To reduce bleeding effect from grouting use BAL Protective Sealer

Directions for use: Apply with a clean colour-fast lint-free cloth. Rub well into tile surface but avoid application to un-grouted joints. Allow 15 minutes for sealer first coat to dry. Apply a second coat and leave to dry for minimum of 1 hour before grouting.

Initial Clean
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.
For removal of cementitious residues use Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:30 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Remove any residues using a cloth or vacuum and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Protect
Due to the high porosity of the tile surface you are required to seal the tiles before grouting, using Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer.

Directions for use: Allow the surface to dry for at least 12 hours before sealing the surface. Using a brush, application pad or cloth, apply Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer to saturation. Gently work the product into the surface ensuring an even application over the tiles surface. Remove any excess product that has not absorbed into the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the maintenance of this tile.

description:
With its soft light blue hues and crackle glaze, the Astrea™ duck egg tile evokes the romance of the French countryside. Our Astrea™ collection is also inspired by the distinctive glazes of Celadon ceramics. Cut with a wet cutter and a silver or gold blade from Topps Tiles.

Due to the crackle glaze on this tile, BAL protective sealer is required prior to grouting to reduce the amount of bleeding caused by the grout. The grout used should be a minimal contrast rather than using an extreme contrast as this could cause the tiles to stain.

name: Metro Grey Tile
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Ideal for giving classic décor a contemporary feel, the Metro deep blue tile is ideal for adding a splash of vibrant colour to walls. name: Metro Sage Tile
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Starluxe™ Grey Tile (30cm x 30cm)
tile_care:
PLEASE NOTE: Our Starluxe tiles have a low porosity due to their resin content, this means they do not absorb moisture well so standard adhesives mixed with water only are not suitable for the fixing of these tiles. An adhesive with a latex additive is required to ensure the bond between tile and adhesive. To fix these tiles, BAL All-In-One can be added to cementitious adhesives, or (for quarts tiles up to 60cm x 60cm) our Kerakoll gel adhesives used as a 1 part solution without the need for a latex additive. For any further assistance or advice please contact your local store.

Quartz Resin tiles should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline can damage the stone whilst also reducing the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used.

PREPARE: After grouting for an initial clean, use diluted residue remover for honed and polished stone. Allow the residue remover to sit on the tile at least 10 minutes to allow the grout residue to be broken down. The use of an emulsifying pad will aid with removal of grout residue. Sometimes, particularly on a textured surface, after using residue removers there is still some residue which may be due to the polymer within the grout. This needs to be softened with an alkaline detergent. Use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover in the same way as the residue remover.

PROTECT: Most Quartz Resin tiles sold by Topps Tiles are micro sealed at the factory unless otherwise stated on the box. This sealer will last approximately 12 months providing the correct cleaners are used. After this has worn off, you will need to reseal Quartz Resin. 2 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer are required. Apply with either a brush or a roller, allow each coat to dry thoroughly.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they can damage the life of the sealer.

name: Starluxe™ Black Tile (30cm x 30cm)
tile_care:
PLEASE NOTE: Our Starluxe tiles have a low porosity due to their resin content, this means they do not absorb moisture well so standard adhesives mixed with water only are not suitable for the fixing of these tiles. An adhesive with a latex additive is required to ensure the bond between tile and adhesive. To fix these tiles, BAL All-In-One can be added to cementitious adhesives, or (for quarts tiles up to 60cm x 60cm) our Kerakoll gel adhesives used as a 1 part solution without the need for a latex additive. For any further assistance or advice please contact your local store.

Quartz Resin tiles should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline can damage the stone whilst also reducing the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used.

PREPARE: After grouting for an initial clean, use diluted residue remover for honed and polished stone. Allow the residue remover to sit on the tile at least 10 minutes to allow the grout residue to be broken down. The use of an emulsifying pad will aid with removal of grout residue. Sometimes, particularly on a textured surface, after using residue removers there is still some residue which may be due to the polymer within the grout. This needs to be softened with an alkaline detergent. Use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover in the same way as the residue remover.

PROTECT: Most Quartz Resin tiles sold by Topps Tiles are micro sealed at the factory unless otherwise stated on the box. This sealer will last approximately 12 months providing the correct cleaners are used. After this has worn off, you will need to reseal Quartz Resin. 2 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer are required. Apply with either a brush or a roller, allow each coat to dry thoroughly.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they can damage the life of the sealer.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. name: Starluxe™ White Tile (60cm x 60cm)
tile_care:
PLEASE NOTE: Our Starluxe tiles have a low porosity due to their resin content, this means they do not absorb moisture well so standard adhesives mixed with water only are not suitable for the fixing of these tiles. An adhesive with a latex additive is required to ensure the bond between tile and adhesive. To fix these tiles, BAL All-In-One can be added to cementitious adhesives, or (for quarts tiles up to 60cm x 60cm) our Kerakoll gel adhesives used as a 1 part solution without the need for a latex additive. For any further assistance or advice please contact your local store.

Quartz Resin tiles should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline can damage the stone whilst also reducing the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used.

PREPARE: After grouting for an initial clean, use diluted residue remover for honed and polished stone. Allow the residue remover to sit on the tile at least 10 minutes to allow the grout residue to be broken down. The use of an emulsifying pad will aid with removal of grout residue. Sometimes, particularly on a textured surface, after using residue removers there is still some residue which may be due to the polymer within the grout. This needs to be softened with an alkaline detergent. Use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover in the same way as the residue remover.

PROTECT: Most Quartz Resin tiles sold by Topps Tiles are micro sealed at the factory unless otherwise stated on the box. This sealer will last approximately 12 months providing the correct cleaners are used. After this has worn off, you will need to reseal Quartz Resin. 2 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer are required. Apply with either a brush or a roller, allow each coat to dry thoroughly.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they can damage the life of the sealer.

Despite the design’s delicate look, durable hard quartz and resin mean it is resistant to scratches and stains and can be used with electric underfloor heating (to a max. temperature of 27˚C) ideal for use in bustling areas of the home, however there a few essential fixing requirements needed when choosing quartz tiles, read our informative article for full details.

Recycled Content Used: 70%

name: Starluxe™ White Tile (30cm x 60cm)
tile_care:
PLEASE NOTE: Our Starluxe tiles have a low porosity due to their resin content, this means they do not absorb moisture well so standard adhesives mixed with water only are not suitable for the fixing of these tiles. An adhesive with a latex additive is required to ensure the bond between tile and adhesive. To fix these tiles, BAL All-In-One can be added to cementitious adhesives, or (for quarts tiles up to 60cm x 60cm) our Kerakoll gel adhesives used as a 1 part solution without the need for a latex additive. For any further assistance or advice please contact your local store.

Quartz Resin tiles should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline can damage the stone whilst also reducing the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used.

PREPARE: After grouting for an initial clean, use diluted residue remover for honed and polished stone. Allow the residue remover to sit on the tile at least 10 minutes to allow the grout residue to be broken down. The use of an emulsifying pad will aid with removal of grout residue. Sometimes, particularly on a textured surface, after using residue removers there is still some residue which may be due to the polymer within the grout. This needs to be softened with an alkaline detergent. Use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover in the same way as the residue remover.

PROTECT: Most Quartz Resin tiles sold by Topps Tiles are micro sealed at the factory unless otherwise stated on the box. This sealer will last approximately 12 months providing the correct cleaners are used. After this has worn off, you will need to reseal Quartz Resin. 2 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer are required. Apply with either a brush or a roller, allow each coat to dry thoroughly.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they can damage the life of the sealer.

name: Complements™ Grey Classic Tile (5cm x 20cm)
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Antalya Crema Irregular Linear Mosaic Tile

breadcrumbs.label: Antalya Crema Irregular Linear Mosaic Tile

tile_care:
PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. The preparation should be done before and after grouting.

PROTECT: Apply in total 3 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer using a brush or a roller, allowing each coat to dry thoroughly. A 1ltr bottle will cover approx. 10m2. The first coat should be applied after the initial cleaning but before grouting as a pre-seal, to help prevent absorption of grout into the tile. The second and third coats should be applied after the grouting and cleaning process.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted at a ration od 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection.

ENHANCE: Unpolished Limestone can be enhanced using Fila Colour Intensifier and in this case one coat of Fila Natural Stainproof Sealer should be applied before grouting, and after cleaning apply 2 coats of Fila Colour Intensifier once the limestone is dry.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on limestone. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

name: Catania™ Green Tile
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: NSM Travertine / Marble Tumbled Mosaic Tile

breadcrumbs.label: NSM Travertine / Marble Tumbled Mosaic Tile

product_name_2: NSM Travertine / Marble Tumbled Mosaic Tile
tile_care:
Travertine and Marble are very soft stones and should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline will damage the stone and reduce the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used on the stone.

PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. Sometimes after using a residue remover, residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

PROTECT:Apply Natural Look Stainproof Sealer undiluted onto a clean, dry surface using a brush or microfiber application pad. Leave the product to penetrate the tile and grout surface. Remove any excess within 15 minutes by rubbing the surface with a clean, dry cloth. For very absorbent materials such as Limestone & unpolished stone, apply a second coat within 20minutes of the first, following the same directions. The treated surface should not appear shiny or have a film.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection

ENHANCE: Unpolished travertine can be enhanced using Fila Colour Intensifier. After using Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover and when the travertine is dry, apply 2 coats of Fila Colour Intensifier.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on travertine. Travertine does not require pre-sealing. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

name: Grosvenor™ Black/Blue Border Tile
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Travertine Tile (20cm x 40cm)
tile_care:
Travertine and Marble are very soft stones and should be maintained using PH neutral products as acid and alkaline will damage the stone and reduce the effectiveness of any sealers that have been used on the stone.

PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. Sometimes after using a residue remover, residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

PROTECT:Apply Natural Look Stainproof Sealer undiluted onto a clean, dry surface using a brush or microfiber application pad. Leave the product to penetrate the tile and grout surface. Remove any excess within 15 minutes by rubbing the surface with a clean, dry cloth. For very absorbent materials such as Limestone & unpolished stone, apply a second coat within 20minutes of the first, following the same directions. The treated surface should not appear shiny or have a film.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection

ENHANCE: Unpolished travertine can be enhanced using Fila Colour Intensifier. After using Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover and when the travertine is dry, apply 2 coats of Fila Colour Intensifier.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on travertine. Travertine does not require pre-sealing. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

name: Split Face Autonno Blend Tile
tile_care:
Most slate will vary in thickness. (This is an inherent property of slate and adds to the rustic look.) To obtain a finish with all the tiles at the same level the tiles will need to be examined and laying should begin with the thickest tile, the remainder tiles should then be brought up to the same level.

(Please note, Split Face mosaic tiles do not require grouting)

PREPARE: After grouting for an initial clean, use diluted residue remover for honed and polished stone. Allow the residue remover to sit on the tile at least 10 minutes to allow the grout residue to be broken down. The use of an emulsifying pad will aid with removal of grout residue. Sometimes, particularly on a textured surface, after using residue removers there is still some residue which may be due to the polymer within the grout. This needs to be softened with an alkaline detergent. Use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover in the same way as the residue remover.

PROTECT: Use Natural Look Stainproof Sealer, 2 coats are required. Apply with either a brush or a roller and allow each coat to dry thoroughly. A Colour Intensifier may be used after the initial coat if desired.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted.

Acidic or highly Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they will damage the life of the sealer.

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.


Travertine is a natural stone. The colour and pattern variations in the tiles are due to the way they're made and are part of their charm. To ensure you get a good mix of shades across your area, we recommend laying out your tiles before fixing. For very large areas, please talk to our experts in store for advice.

name: Devon Grey Rectified Edge Tile
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Travertine Filled & Honed Floor Tile
tile_care:
Most textured tiles will not require sealing, however due to the nature of the textured surface they are prone to retaining grout in the crevices on the front making grout cleaning more difficult. If the grout is not cleaned off correctly, the tile will look like it has been stained and have a grout residue left on.

PREPARE: Before grouting you should apply BAL Protective Sealer, in some cases 2 coats will make grout cleaning an easier process by stopping the grout sticking to the tile. It should be applied with a clean colour fast lint free cloth. The first coat should be left to dry for at least 15 minutes. The second coat must be left a minimum of 1 hour to dry.

GROUTING: Grouting should be carried out using a hard grout float as it is less likely to fill all the voids of the tile with grout.If using a rapid set grout so not allow the grout to sit on the tile for longer than 15 minutes.

CLEAN: After grouting a grout clean up pad should be used to remove any excess from the tile. Once dry the tile should be buffed to remove any final residue. (Grout should not be left in contact with a tile for more than 15 minutes). To remove protective sealer the tile will need to be cleaned at least twice using Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted. This can also be used to maintain the tile for ongoing cleaning requirements.

Acidic or highly Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for maintenance of this tile as they will damage the life of the sealer.

name: Amazone™ Beige Modular Tumbled Tile

media.alt_text: Amazone™ Beige Modular Tumbled Tile fitted on hallway floor with rustic bench and wellington boots on floor.

tile_care:
PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. The preparation should be done before and after grouting.

PROTECT: Apply in total 3 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer using a brush or a roller, allowing each coat to dry thoroughly. A 1ltr bottle will cover approx. 10m2. The first coat should be applied after the initial cleaning but before grouting as a pre-seal, to help prevent absorption of grout into the tile. The second and third coats should be applied after the grouting and cleaning process.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted at a ration od 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection.

ENHANCE: Unpolished Limestone can be enhanced using Fila Colour Intensifier and in this case one coat of Fila Natural Stainproof Sealer should be applied before grouting, and after cleaning apply 2 coats of Fila Colour Intensifier once the limestone is dry.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on limestone. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

description:
The inspiration for the Amazone™ beige modular tumbled tile is taken from the world's lushest jungle. With its unpolished finish, it brings a touch of raw and imperfect beauty to your home. Characterised by  differences in texture, the stone's natural properties create a distinctive mottled look that evokes the worn and weathered charm of vintage French flagstones. The attractive light tones of this tile are perfect for bringing warmth into a rustic living space. To ensure you get a good mix of shades across the area, lay out your tiles before fixing them for a pattern that looks truly unique. Using an unpolished protector or colour intensifier will protect the floor from spills and also enhance the look of the quarried stone.

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

Due to the inherent properties of our Amazone™ stone, it is expected that on occasion, the overall look will appear more rustic and mottled. This is caused by the varying porosity and density of the stone itself. The use of Unpolished Protector and/or Colour Intensifier will give greater definition to this variation. As you can see from images 4 and 5, this characteristic enhances the beauty of the overall appearance. Please note, this is not a product fault, but a natural characteristic of the stone.

name: Lemon Marble Tumbled Mosaic Tile
tile_care:
PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a soft white emulsifying pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. Sometimes after using a Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover, residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

PROTECT: Apply Natural Look Stainproof Sealer undiluted onto a clean, dry surface using a brush or microfiber application pad. Leave the product to penetrate the tile and grout surface. Remove any excess within 15 minutes by rubbing the surface with a clean, dry cloth. For very absorbent materials such as Limestone & unpolished stone, apply a second coat within 20minutes of the first, following the same directions. The treated surface should not appear shiny or have a film.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted 1:200.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on marble. Marble does not require pre-sealing. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

PREPARE: Diluted First Wash 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. Sometimes after using a First Wash, residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances use Tile and Stone Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the First Wash.

PROTECT: If using Polished Protector, for polished travertine, apply 1 coat using a brush or a roller. A 1ltr bottle will cover approx. 30m2. If using Unpolished Protector, for unpolished travertine, apply 2 coats using a brush or a roller. Apply the second coat within 4 hours of the first coat. A 1ltr bottle will cover approx. 30m2.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Tile & Stone Cleaner diluted 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection

ENHANCE: Unpolished travertine can be enhanced using Colour Intensifier. After using First Wash and when the travertine is dry, apply 2 coats of Colour Intensifier.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on travertine. Travertine does not require pre-sealing. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

description:
These brick effect mosaic tiles have an authentic style and an earthy colourway that will add a rustic aesthetic to your interiors. Crafted from travertine, a derivative of limestone, these tiles have a traditional pattern with natural pits and voids, meaning each one is unique. 

Suitable for use with underfloor heating providing the correct substrate preparation and a suitable flexible cement based tile adhesive and grouts are used. For more information on fitting please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

As they're made of natural stone, the colour and patterns will vary. We advise laying out all the tiles beforehand to get an idea of what the finished design will look like.

description:
With its light, warm grey tones, the Split Face oyster tile gives an airy feel to your living space. The rectangular natural quartzite has a three dimensional appearance with an unpolished finish. Known for its versatility and durability, this Topps Tiles exclusive is a popular choice for both in and outdoor use. Its naturally formed layers and textures, varying from tile to tile, bring a touch of the wild outdoors in. We recommend laying out your tiles before fixing large areas to ensure you get a good mix of shades – consult our experts in store if you need further advice. 


These tiles have outstanding stability and adaptability, perfect for charming outdoor spaces, but you'll need to ensure the tile is back buttered during installation and correctly sealed. It must also be placed out of direct contact with water or have a lip or ledge to be fixed to the top of the tiled wall to ensure no constant contact with water is made and to prevent water running behind the tile. Because it's made from natural stone, the product may have sharp edges.

It is specifically for use to fix tiles to walls and floors where the installation of a radiant source of heat is specified. The surface temperature surrounding the heat radiating item should be no more than 250°C.

It is not suitable for use on fire surrounds and surfaces which may be exposed to direct contact with a flame of a gas burner.

  • High initial strength
  • Suitable for use around a radiant heat source up to 250°
  • Easy to apply non-slump mortar

  • Up to 40 minute work time depending on ambient temperature

description:
Meet BAL’s Micromax 3 Eco grout range, a rapid-setting, rapid-hardening and highly flexible cementitious tiling grout.

Micromax 3 has an efflorescence-free formulation minimising the risk of patchy discolouration from over washing the grout joints. Available in a wide range of colours, the MM3 range sets in 2-3 hours (at 20°C), has built-in Microban® antimicrobial protection for walls and floors, which inhibits the growth of bacteria, and works with joint widths of 1-30mm making it suitable for power showers, wet rooms, heated floors, and timber floors.

This water and frost resistant grout features 25% recycled content and is packaged in recyclable packaging. The matching range of silicone enables you to create a seamless, professional finish.

name: Amazone™ Grey Modular Tumbled Tile

media.alt_text: Amazone™ Grey Modular Tumbled Tile on floor with rattan dining table and chairs.
Amazone™ Grey Modular Tumbled Tile fitted on bathroom floor with white wall hung toilet and wooden under sink drawer unit.

tile_care:
PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a suitable pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. The preparation should be done before and after grouting.

PROTECT: Apply in total 3 coats of Fila Natural Look Stainproof Sealer using a brush or a roller, allowing each coat to dry thoroughly. A 1ltr bottle will cover approx. 10m2. The first coat should be applied after the initial cleaning but before grouting as a pre-seal, to help prevent absorption of grout into the tile. The second and third coats should be applied after the grouting and cleaning process.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted at a ration od 1:200. Using the correct cleaning product ensures the life span of the protection.

ENHANCE: Unpolished Limestone can be enhanced using Fila Colour Intensifier and in this case one coat of Fila Natural Stainproof Sealer should be applied before grouting, and after cleaning apply 2 coats of Fila Colour Intensifier once the limestone is dry.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on limestone. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

meta.title: Amazone™ Grey Modular Tumbled Tile | Topps Tiles

description:
This Amazone™ modular tumbled tile in a subtle mid grey tone is made from natural stone and named after the lush jungles of South America. Its natural variations in pattern and hue are perfect for creating a rustic aesthetic. Try using an unpolished protector or colour intensifier to enhance the warm, mottled effect. The tumbled edges provide vintage charm, emulating the look of worn French flagstones. Consider laying out your tiles dry before fixing them to help you achieve the mix of shades you're looking for.

Due to the inherent properties of our Amazone™ stone, it is expected that on occasion, the overall look will appear more rustic and mottled. This is caused by the varying porosity and density of the stone itself. The use of Unpolished Protector and/or Colour Intensifier will give greater definition to this variation. Please note, this is not a product fault, but a natural characteristic of the stone

name: Carrara Honed Marble Tile (61cm x 61cm)
tile_care:
PREPARE: Diluted Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover 1:30 covers 50m2. Allow the solution to sit on the tile for 5 minutes and work residue off with a soft white emulsifying pad or cloth. Rinse thoroughly with clean water. Sometimes after using a Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover, residues may be left behind; this may be due to the polymer within the grout. In these instances use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover diluted 1:5 in the same way as the Fila Stone Cement Residue Remover.

PROTECT: Apply Natural Look Stainproof Sealer undiluted onto a clean, dry surface using a brush or microfiber application pad. Leave the product to penetrate the tile and grout surface. Remove any excess within 15 minutes by rubbing the surface with a clean, dry cloth. For very absorbent materials such as Limestone & unpolished stone, apply a second coat within 20minutes of the first, following the same directions. The treated surface should not appear shiny or have a film.

CLEAN: To prevent the build-up of deposits it is important that the correct cleaner is used, to maintain the tiles we suggest Fila Multi Surface Cleaner diluted 1:200.

PLEASE NOTE: Acidic or Alkaline cleaners are not recommended for use on marble. Marble does not require pre-sealing. Contrasting grouts can cause staining, so it is advised to test the grout on a small area before grouting commences.

name: Everscape™ Enis™ Black Slate Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Enis™ Black Slate Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)

tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It's hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety.

The Enis range mixes the classic texture of slate with a modern colour palette to revamp any outdoor space. The rustic nature of the slate effect pairs perfectly with soft greenery and slow-moving water.

Capture the natural element inside too with the coordinating 1cm indoor tile. You can match the ProScape grout with one of our coordinating indoor BAL Micromax3 grouts for a seamless transition from the outdoors in.

Key Product Features:

  • Variety of sizes and formats available
  • 2cm depth
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available
  • Coordinating indoor tiles available

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.title: Foundry™ Wax 50g | Topps Tiles

description:
The Foundry range from Topps Tiles is a pioneering collection of luxury brass trims developed in collaboration with a specialist manufacturer to bring you the very latest innovation in decorative finishes. As a ‘living' product, the natural process of oxidisation results in an organic looking patina on the surface; altering and enhancing the appearance of the trim depending on the environment so no two trims are the same. If desired, the natural process can be slowed down by periodically applying a thin layer of the Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax to the trim's surface, perfect for those who want a unique, living product in their home.

Care & Maintenance

  • When cleaning Foundry trims it is essential to use products that do not contain any chemical or abrasive additives; using clean, clear water is recommended with a non-abrasive cloth which will prevent any scratching to the tile surface
  • Once the surface has been cleaned, a thin layer of Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax can be re-applied with a clean cloth to slow down the natural oxidisation process. For best care use the lint-free cloth provided
  • Built-up oxidisation layers can be removed using conventional polishing agents together with a non-abrasive cloth and re-application of Topps Tiles Foundry Beeswax

This is part 2 of a 2 part leveller. Part 1 is 20kg of powder and part 2 is 4Ltr of liquid. Please ensure you add the same quantity of part 1 powder (code 718532) to your purchase in order to have the complete set.

Ultra floor level IT two is a two part self-levelling compound that combines excellent flow characteristics with strong adhesion properties through the inclusion of a synthetic latex liquid component. Suitable for use over cementitious floor substrates, hard adhesives residues, asphalt and timber, and can also be used under ultra-floor damp proof membranes.

Feature and Benefits:

  • Rapid setting
  • Non shrink
  • Self-levelling
  • Low odour
  • 2-15mm depth
  • Suitable for Underfloor heating
  • Super fine finish
  • Ideal for timber substrates
  • Can be used under a damp proof membrane
  • Protein free
  • Polymer modified to enhance flexibility
  • Surface preparation

 

The surface being adhered to must be clean, firm, dry, free of dust, dirt, oil and grease or any other contaminating barriers. Remove any flaking or peeling layers. The substrate must be strong enough to support the weight of the adhesive and the covering being fixed. If this product is applied on wood, it should only be used as a coating of up to 5mm to smooth boards before overlaying tiles. Direct to earth sub-floors must have Ultra floor damp proof membrane IT applied to them prior to the use of this product.

Priming
Both porous and non-porous surfaces should be primed using BAL primer.

product_name_2: Warmup Tempo Digital Programmable Thermostat Black

meta.title: Warmup Element Tempo Black | Topps Tiles

description:
The Tempo is an attractive digital programmable thermostat for use with underfloor heating. The interface has been created with speed and ease in mind - intuitive, tactile and responsive.

The Tempo is capable of up to a 16A switching load at 250V, and is supplied with both an internal air sensor and a floor sensor. The Tempo mounts in a 35mm back box and has a Full Week, 5/2 and 7 Individual Day programming options.

It is suitable for use with WarmUp underfloor heating products up to 16A.

All Warmup programmable thermostats purchased now come with the option of a free upgrade to an extended lifetime warranty, exclusive to Topps Tiles. Please retain your proof of purchase to register and claim your free upgrade. 

To maintain the guarantee of the matt / loose wire we recommend purchasing the UFH thermostat together with a full system from the same range.

For more information and installation advice please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

name: Warmup Insulating Board 6mm
category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Electric Underfloor heating / Under Tile Insulation

media.alt_text: Warmup 6mm Insulating Board.

meta.title: Warmup Insulating Board 6mm | Topps Tiles

description:
Warmup insulation boards have a key role to play in maximising the efficiency of underfloor heating. Insulation is not only needed to comply with Building Regulations but improves efficiency, increases responsiveness of the heating system and ensures that any heat generated is not lost. Insulation boards are water resistant, insulated tile backer board made of extruded polystyrene, faced on both sides with a fibreglass mesh embedded into a thin cement polymer mortar.

The insulation boards have a high thermal insulation property for energy efficiency and an added benefit of sound proofing. They can be used on walls or floors and are ideal for applications such as dry lining, insulating and waterproofing in areas such as wetrooms, bathrooms and kitchens.

For more information and installation advice please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

name: Warmup Prowire 10m Under Tile Heating
category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Electric Underfloor heating / Under-Tile Heating

meta.title: Warmup Prowire 10 - 10.0m Under Tile Heating | Topps Tiles

description:
The ProWire system is EXCLUSIVE TO TOPPS TILES. It is a loose wire system kit from Warmup, the world's best-selling electric underfloor heating brand. ProWire is an upgrade of the current Warmup DWS package, designed specifically for the professional installer. It sits between traditional methods such as matting systems and primer applications for loose wire systems.

The ProWire installation method consists mainly of two tapes. A double-sided highly adhesive tape and a fibre glass mesh tape. The adhesive tape is put across the section of area where the cable is laid. This tape holds the wire during installation. Because it is double-sided and highly adhesive, installers do not need to use primer. The mesh tape is placed on top of the double-sided tape after the wire has been laid, securely fixing the wire for full contact with the subfloor. This ensures that the cable does not detach with mechanical impact or during the application of wet tile adhesive.

It offers a highly adhesive tape which avoids the use of primer altogether. Using ProWire can reduce your installation time by 50% when compared against the installation time of the current method using primer – saving you time and money!

The ProWire system comes in sizes 3m², 4m², 5m², 6m² and 10m², with an output of 150w/m² and are BEAB approved.

All systems are compatible with Warmup's 3iE energy-monitor thermostats and come with Warmup's unique Lifetime and SafetyNet Installation guarantees.

Features & Benefits include:

  • Rapid installation in any size or shape room
  • Cuts installation time by up to 50% depending on size and shape of room
  • Flexibility of a loose wire with speed of a mat
  • Fully 3iE™ compatible – works with energy monitor software
  • Powerful: 150W/m² output
  • WARMUP® LIFETIME GUARANTEE
  • WARMUP® Safety-Net™ GUARANTEE
  • Cheaper for many larger areas
  • Cheaper than smaller PFM mats
  • Inner insulation: ECTFE (advanced fluoropolymers) for higher durability
  • Outer insulation: ECTFE (advanced fluoropolymers) for higher durability
  • Ultrathin wire

To maintain the guarantee of the matt / loose wire we recommend purchasing the UFH thermostat together with a full system from the same range.

For more information and installation advice please visit our knowledge base or contact your local store.

  • Specially developed to absorb heavy stresses and spread them evenly across the floor and foundations.
  • The metal profile makes it ideal for heavy footfall areas, such as shopping centres.
  • Width: 10mm; depth: 10mm; length: 2.5mm (other depths available).
  • The epoxy compound infill absorbs up to 20% across the joint width.
  • There are certain circumstances where you must use a movement joint: in a floor with a joint in the sub-floor (you have to follow this through into the tiled surface); where there's a structural movement joint (again, follow it through onto the surface of the tile); on suspended floors; directly over the junction of two substrates (such as screed to timber); and where the tiling area is greater than 10m x 10m (with no one side exceeding 10m in length).
  • If you're working with a heated floor, use the movement joint where the tiling area is greater than 40m², and no one side exceeds 8m in length.
  • Before installation, make sure your movement joint is the right profile for the thickness of the tiles.
  • Apply tile adhesive to the junction with a trowel, and press the profile into the adhesive, aligning it to the tiles.
  • Spread the tile adhesive over the entire surface of the joint, and fit the tiles into the adhesive, aligning them so that they're flush with the top edge of the profile.
  • Allow a joint of 2mm around the profile, and fill this with grout.

description:
The 12mm HardieBacker® 500 cement board is ideal for walls that are likely to get wet such as bathrooms, kitchens, and steam rooms. Each board can carry applied weights of up to 200kg/m², meaning you can strengthen regular plastered walls for heavier tile application.

Using James Hardie’s unique proprietary cement formulation, the board provides a strong bond for all ceramic and natural stone tiles whilst incorporating water resistant properties and Mouldblock™ technology. There’s no paper facing or gypsum, that can mould or disintegrate over time, ensuring dimensional stability when exposed to water for long periods of time.

Easy to cut and install, its mesh free construction and smooth surface can be textured or wallpapered and provides a strong bond with tile adhesive for tiling. You can even use this 12mm board vertically on external walls for render, brickslip, tiles and external grade paint from 150mm above ground level.

Internally, the board is also suitable for creating additional height in flooring or worktop applications.

description:
The RUBIMIX-8 N is a high-performance 1400W electric mixer designed specifically for the tiling professional. Engineered for versatility, it effortlessly handles a wide range of materials, from viscous cementitious adhesives and resins to paints and mortars. Its lightweight construction is paired with a double-grip ergonomic handle, ensuring maximum comfort and reduced fatigue during extended use.

This mixer features an electronic speed regulator, allowing you to fine-tune the 0–750 RPM range to achieve a perfectly homogeneous mix every time. Whether you are mixing large batches of grout or heavy-duty adhesive, the RUBIMIX-8 N provides the reliability and precision required on a busy job site.

  • High-Torque 1400W Motor: Delivers consistent power for mixing heavy, viscous materials like tile adhesive, grout, and resin.
  • Variable Speed Control: Features an electronic regulator (0-750 RPM) to optimize the mixing speed for different materials, preventing splashes and ensuring a smooth consistency.
  • Ergonomic Double Grip: Designed with bi-material handles for improved comfort and stability, offering better control during high-torque mixing.
  • Safety First: Includes a safety lock switch on the handle to prevent accidental start-ups and corner protectors to shield the tool from impact on-site.
  • Universal Compatibility: Equipped with a standard M14 thread connection, making it compatible with a wide range of mixing paddles. It can also be adapted for non-threaded rods or the FAST-IN system (sold separately).
  • Ready to Work: Comes complete with a 120mm removable mixing paddle, ideal for mixing up to 25kg of mortar or adhesive right out of the box.
  • Professional Durability: Built with lightweight, high-resistance materials and backed by a 2-year warranty (plus extra points for Rubi Club members).
