name: Everscape™ Marstone Silver Outdoor Tile (60cm x 90cm)

breadcrumbs.label: Everscape™ Marstone Silver Outdoor Tile (60cm x 90cm)

tile_care:
Everscape is a range of 20mm Porcelain tiles, which will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax2 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray FILA Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila First Wash Extra Strong

Directions for use: Dilute FILA First Wash Extra Strong 1:5 with clean water (1 litre First Wash with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute FILA Tile & Stone Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Protector.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Tile & Stone Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.title: Everscape™ | Topps Tiles

short_description: Marstone provides the look of natural stone into the garden with a surface that shows gentle movement and warmer undertones, so your outdoors feels more inviting. The Silver, Taupe and Cedar colours each offer their own character, from cool mineral shades to richer earthy tones, so the tiles settle naturally into a wide range of garden styles...
description:
Outdoor tiles to make the most of every day.

Extend your style outside and learn to love your garden all year round! From sun drenched patios and secret courtyard gardens to cosy city balconies and breezy beachfront terraces, our exclusive range of outdoor tiles will help transform every corner of your home into spaces you’ll never want to leave, creating the perfect space for endless summers.

Everscape is a range of specialised 2cm deep outdoor tiles with an amalgamation of ‘forever’ and ‘landscape’ embodied in its spirit. This combination of elegant, simple design married with innovative technology allows you to make a real investment in your outdoor space for years to come.

It's hardwearing porcelain meaning little upkeep is needed and with multiple ways to fit it, it’s an easy DIY solution for the budding landscape designer in all of us. The 2cm depth coupled with the slip resistant surface provides ultimate durability and safety all year round.

Marstone provides the look of natural stone into the garden with a surface that shows gentle movement and warmer undertones, so your outdoors feels more inviting. The Silver, Taupe and Cedar colours each offer their own character, from cool mineral shades to richer earthy tones, so the tiles settle naturally into a wide range of garden styles. The elongated 60×90 size creates broad sections of stone that read beautifully across patios and walkways, keeping the design calm while still feeling substantial.

Key Product Features:

  • 60x90 XL Format 
  • 2cm depth
  • High slip resistance
  • Nonporous so tiles won’t ‘pop’ or crack in freezing temperatures
  • No specialist sealing or cleaning required
  • Suitable for use with a pressure washer
  • Multiple fitting solutions available
  • A range of complementary finishing accessories are available

 

Complete your Everscape tiling project with our one-stop shop for outdoor tiling. Choose from our range of outdoor adhesives, leveller, pedestals systems, outdoor suitable grouts, finishing trims as well as outdoor tools and cutters. And once your project is complete, help maintain your finished patio with the Fila Outdoor Patio Cleaner.

Fitting the Everscape range yourself? Check out the fitting guides on our Knowledge Base for some useful tips for laying on grass, gravel, cement, and pedestals.

name: Tarssian Oak Tile (100cm x 100cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

A distinctive wood-effect tile that reinterprets classic parquet through a bold 100×100 format, Tarssian’s design feels architectural and confident, with geometric detailing that stands apart from traditional plank styles and gives a room a contemporary edge. The matt finish keeps reflections soft so the pattern becomes the focus, while relief reader technology adds convincing texture that follows the design rather than sitting flat on the surface. Across larger areas, the nine tile faces help the floor feel varied and natural, which is particularly effective when the tile runs from a hallway into a living room.

Available in Oak and Walnut tones, Tarssian adapts easily to different interiors. Oak keeps rooms light and modern, while Walnut introduces depth that works well with richer furniture and warmer finishes. The tile is rectified for a clean, well-aligned layout with even grout lines, and its XL format works just as well on walls as it does on floors. Designed for indoor use, Tarssian suits living spaces throughout the home where its pattern and scale can be fully appreciated.

The matt finish keeps reflections soft so the pattern becomes the focus, while relief reader technology adds convincing texture that follows the design rather than sitting flat on the surface. Across larger areas, the nine tile faces help the floor feel varied and natural, which is particularly effective when the tile runs from a hallway into a living room.

Available in Oak and Walnut tones, Tarssian adapts easily to different interiors. Oak keeps rooms light and modern, while Walnut introduces depth that works well with richer furniture and warmer finishes. The tile is rectified for a clean, well-aligned layout with even grout lines, and its XL format works just as well on walls as it does on floors. Designed for indoor use, Tarssian suits living spaces throughout the home where its pattern and scale can be fully appreciated.

category_path: Fixing and Finishing / Tools and accessories / Hand tools

meta.title: DEX Manual Pump Suction Cup | Topps Tiles

description:
Designed to support the safe lifting of large format and heavy tiles, the DEX Manual Pump Suction Cup offers reliable grip across a wide range of surfaces, including smooth, polished, uneven and rough finishes. With a maximum lifting capacity of 110kg, it provides the strength needed for handling bigger tiles during installation.

Activate the suction by pressing the pump repeatedly until the indicator reaches the safe line, ensuring full and secure contact before lifting. Once the tile is in place, release the pressure by pulling the manual release tab for a controlled removal.

The 200mm rubber suction pad should be kept clean for best performance. A wipe with a damp cloth is all that’s required, while avoiding alcohol based cleaners helps preserve the rubber over time.

name: Florrial Blue Tile (20cm x 20cm)

media.alt_text: Statements™ Florrial  patterned blue tile fitted on bathroom floor with a white freestanding bathtub and wooden stool.
Statements™ Florrial  patterned blue tile fitted on kitchen floor with wooden dining table with bench.

tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.description: Azpects Easy Joint Porcelain Brush-In Grout
meta.title: Azpects Easy Joint Porcelain Brush-In Grout | Topps Tiles
meta.keywords: Azpects Easy Joint Porcelain Brush-In Grout

description:
Azpects EASYJoint Porcelain is a ready to use patio jointing compound formulated specifically for porcelain paving. The dry application cures to a hard, non-permeable finish suitable for both interior and exterior use, producing strong joints with consistent colour in every application. Available in Silver and White Gold, it complements a wide range of porcelain tiles.

The compound is applied dry and brushed into the joints before being lightly wetted and compacted, removing the need for mixing on site. It is suitable for joint widths from 3mm to 13mm and a minimum depth of 19mm, with a typical drying period of 24 to 48 hours depending on temperature and weather conditions. Early exposure to rain can delay the cure, and drying may take longer in colder or damp conditions.

description:
Stone surfaces often reveal their detail through light, and Inigo is designed to make the most of that effect. Carving inks are used to follow the veining across the tile, giving the surface a slight relief that becomes more noticeable as the light moves across it. This added texture gives the design a more natural, layered character than a standard printed finish.

Available in grey and beige, the extra-large 60×120cm format allows the pattern to flow more freely across the surface, with six different faces helping the veining vary from tile to tile so the overall look feels less repetitive. Rectified edges keep the installation neat and controlled, with a minimum 3mm grout joint recommended and a trim size of at least 10mm suggested for the best finish.

description:
A more refined take on slate effect, this larger format tile slightly softens the texture of the original Enis design, creating a smoother finish across the surface. The detail is still there, but its 120x60cm size changes how the pattern reads across a space, helping it feel more open and continuous, particularly in larger rooms. Available in black, grey and ivory, the palette suits both lighter, softer schemes and darker, more defined interiors.

Made from matt porcelain, these Enis XL tiles work across both walls and floors, indoors and in outdoor settings, while eight face variations help the design shift naturally as it’s laid. To carry the same look outside, coordinating 2cm outdoor porcelain tiles are also available within the Enis range.

short_description: Carrara is the purest expression of white marble in the range. description:
Crafted in Italy and available in six colourways that span the full breadth of marble design, Galletti is a range that takes its inspiration seriously. The natural veining and depth across each tile gives it a genuine luxury quality that suits both the grandeur of a chequerboard floor and the sophistication of a striped wall, and the palette moves confidently from the soft luminosity of Carrara and Calacatta Gold through the warmth of Crema and Brown to the rich intensity of Verde and Nero.

Carrara is the purest expression of white marble in the range. The fine, feathery grey veining sits quietly across a bright white base, never overpowering the surface but always present enough to remind you it is marble. It pairs well with almost anything else in the range, but comes into its own alongside Verde or Nero in a chequerboard where the contrast does the rest of the work.

With 12 face variations across the 30x30cm format, the marble effect develops naturally across walls and floors. Rectified edges allow for precise, clean joints and the format is designed to coordinate with the 7.5x30cm plank, opening up a wide range of laying patterns across a single scheme.

To see the laying patterns you can create with Galletti, take a look at our Galletti laying patterns guide.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Crafted in Italy and available in six colourways that span the full breadth of marble design, Galletti is a range that takes its inspiration seriously. The natural veining and depth across each tile gives it a genuine luxury quality that suits both the grandeur of a chequerboard floor and the sophistication of a striped wall, and the palette moves confidently from the soft luminosity of Carrara and Calacatta Gold through the warmth of Crema and Brown to the rich intensity of Verde and Nero.

Galletti Nero is a deep black marble effect colourway with bold white and silver veining that cuts dramatically across the surface. The contrast between the dark base and the bright veining gives it an immediate and striking presence on any wall or floor. It works across a wide range of colourways in the palette, but comes into its own alongside Carrara in a chequerboard where the light and dark contrast creates a stunning result.

With 48 face variations across the 7.5x30cm format, the marble effect develops naturally across walls and floors. Rectified edges allow for precise, clean joints and the format is designed to coordinate with the 30x30cm square tile, opening up a wide range of laying patterns across a single scheme.

To see the laying patterns you can create with Galletti, take a look at our Galletti laying patterns guide.

name: Galletti™ Brown Tile (7.5cm x 29.75cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

description:
Recreate the look of slat wood panelling with the added benefit of sound insulating properties. Featuring a real wood veneer finish and a lite profile, these 60x240cm acoustic wall panels are a versatile choice for living rooms, bedrooms, offices and hallways. For a quick DIY solution, the panels can be glued directly to the wall, or fitted to a substrate for enhanced noise reduction.

For a quick DIY solution, these wood panels can also be glued to the wall, offering 25% in noise reduction.

Lite Profile:
- Slimmer 18mm overall depth compared to 21mm in our standard panel range

Features:
- Real wood veneer finish
- Strong felt backing
- Easy maintenance with no need to oil
- Designed for easy one person installation

Slat & Panel Dimensions:
- Slat depth: 18mm including felt, 9mm slat only
- Felt backing depth: 9mm
- Slat width: 27mm
- Gap between slats: 13mm
- Slats Per Panel - 15

To find out more information, view our How To Install Wood Wall Panels guide.

Please note this product is not suitable for bathrooms.

Due to the natural characteristics of wood veneer, these acoustic wood wall panels may experience a slight colour change over time if exposed to direct sunlight.

 Fire Resistant Class: D-s2, d0

Bowden Beige Tile (60cm x 60cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

tile_care:
20mm Porcelain tiles will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

name: Austral Ivory Outdoor Tile (59.5cm x 90cm)
tile_care:
20mm Porcelain tiles will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Winsford™ Graphite Tile (60cm x 90cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Amstel Beige Tile (45cm x 45cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Onea Natural Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)
tile_care:
20mm Porcelain tiles will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Amstel Grey Tile (45cm x 45cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Austral Pearl Outdoor Tile (60cm x 60cm)
tile_care:
20mm Porcelain tiles will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Tenby Beige XL Tile (120cm x 120cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

description:
Meet BAL’s Micromax 3 Eco grout range, a rapid-setting, rapid-hardening and highly flexible cementitious tiling grout.

Micromax 3 has an efflorescence-free formulation minimising the risk of patchy discolouration from over washing the grout joints. This water and frost resistant grout features 25% recycled content and is packaged in recyclable packaging. The matching range of silicone enables you to create a seamless, professional finish.

name: Nodis Natural Tile (10cm x 70cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Simply™ Glossy White Tile (25cm x 40cm)
tile_care:
With highly textured surfaces the use of BAL Protective Sealer may be required. Please ask in store for more details.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.
For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.
A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

name: Claverstone Beige Tile (60cm x 120cm)
tile_care:
Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Once tiles have been fitted all residues must be removed from the surface of the tile, it is important to use the correct cleaner for this.

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: After grouting, wait approximately 10-30 minutes (see manufacturer's instructions) until grout has thickened and become opaque. Carry out an initial clean of the tile surface with a damp sponge. Spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean using a damp sponge.

For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat the above steps

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

Available across three colours and two formats, each variant picks up the fine detail found in natural stone, with the grey offering a soft mid-tone and subtle veining that brings a gentle contrast across the tile...
description:
Claverstone is a delicate stone effect range that channels the look of aged surfaces softened by time. Available across three colours and two formats, each variant picks up the fine detail found in natural stone, with the grey offering a soft mid-tone and subtle veining that brings a gentle contrast across the tile.

Catch it in changing light throughout the day to see the soft antiqued glaze reveal its gently worn, timeless quality. Subtle markings spread across multiple face patterns give every tile its own character, while full body porcelain ensures the grey tone stays consistent right through to cut edges.

A rectified XL format keeps grout lines to a minimum, translating seamlessly from floor to wall to bring that effortless grey contrast into bathrooms, living spaces, and hallways.

description:
Brayford Cream brings the palest tone in the Brayford range, with the same matt finish and lustre glaze picking out the veining that runs through the surface. Held under different light, the glaze catches that veining, giving the surface a gentle sheen while keeping its matt character throughout.

Multiple face patterns mean no two tiles look the same, and the fine grain and veining come across clearly even at close range. Cream is available, like the rest of the range, across 30x60, 60x60 and 60x120 formats, giving you the flexibility to use one size for floors and another for walls.

Rectified edges keep grout lines minimal, so the cream tone reads as one continuous surface, letting the detail carry across the whole run of tiles. A minimum 3mm grout joint and 10mm trim are recommended for the best finish.

For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute 1:5 with clean water and spread the solution over the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 5 minutes. Use a green emulsifying pad and work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse thoroughly with plenty of clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue.

This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner.

For removal of epoxy residues use Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover

Directions for use: Apply Fila Multi Surface Stain Remover undiluted to the surface of the tiles with a cloth. Leave to act for 20 minutes then using an abrasive sponge work the solution over the surface. Clean up the residue and rinse with plenty of clean water.

Do not use on polished Natural Stone, Wood, Acrylic or Plastic surfaces.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute 2 capfuls in to 4 litres of clean water. Apply to the surface and leave to dry; no need to rinse. Covers 100m2 of wall or floor surfaces.

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer

Directions for use: Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.

Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any Fila Grout Sealer residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.

meta.title: Excel Bond Waterproof Tanking 7kg | Topps Tiles

description:
Excel Bond Waterproof Tanking is a one-part, solvent-free liquid membrane designed to protect walls and floors from moisture penetration behind tiles. It is ideal for waterproofing wet rooms, showers, bathrooms, kitchens, and utility rooms before you begin tiling, and is suitable for fully immersed tiling installations.

Applied easily by brush or roller in two coats, the bright yellow liquid dries to form a flexible, water-resistant film at a final depth of 0.8mm to 1mm. This flexible layer copes well with natural substrate movement and vibration, while also acting as a crack isolation membrane to cover cracks and joints up to 3mm wide without additional sealing tape.

The formula is designed for quick project turnarounds. The first coat dries in 1 to 2 hours, and you can begin tiling just 2 hours after applying the final coat.

name: Kansas Bone Outdoor Tile  (60cm x 90cm)
tile_care:
20mm Porcelain tiles will require regular care and maintenance to retain that showroom finish. The specific initial cleaning requirement will depend on the fitting method used and choice of grouting options.

When fixing with Tile Adhesive and finishing with Micromax3 grouts:

Initial Clean (Within 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues within 10-30 minutes of grouting use Fila Instant Grout Remover

Directions for use: Wait approximately 10 to 30 minutes after grouting and working in small areas, spray Fila Instant Grout Remover evenly over the surface and leave for 2 minutes. Clean the surface using a damp sponge. For stubborn stains, leave for 1 hour and repeat this process.

Initial Clean (After 30 minutes of grouting)
For removal of cementitious residues after 30 minutes of grouting use Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Porcelain Cement Residue Remover 1:5 with clean water (1 litre Residue Remover with 5 litres water). Spread the solution over the surface with a cloth and leave to act for 5 minutes. Wipe up any residues and rinse thoroughly with clean water.

A second application maybe necessary to remove any existing residue. This product should not be used neat as the dilution with water activates the ingredients of the cleaner. Always perform a test in a small portion of the surface to verify the acid resistance of the surface.

Routine Maintenance
It is important to regularly maintain the surface of your tiles to prevent the build-up of deposits, to do this use our pH neutral Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Directions for use: Dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:200 with clean water (3 capfuls with 5 litres water). Clean the tile surface using a cloth or mop. There is no need to rinse after cleaning as no residues are left on the surface.

For more stubborn dirt, dilute Fila Multi Surface Cleaner 1:30 with clean water. Spread the solution evenly across the surface and leave to act for 5 minutes. Clean across the surface using a brush and rinse off with plenty of clean water

To maintain the life of your grout use Fila Grout Sealer.

Once grout is completely dry apply the product directly to the grout joint, if using the spray hold the bottle approximately 10-15cm away from the surface area.
Working in small areas (1m2), use a sponge or brush to aid the products penetration over the grout lines. Remove any excess product or smears from the tiles within a 5 minute period using a clean cloth or kitchen roll. Any remaining residues on the surface can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.


Any dry residues that were not removed during application can be removed with Fila Multi Surface Cleaner.

Acidic or highly alkaline cleaners are NOT recommended for the regular maintenance of this tile.
